records.issue_text: [Low/api] app/controllers/groups_controller.rb (members) — response shape changed from serialized array to `{members: ..., meta: {...}}` with no version note, breaking existing API consumers; also uses raw `render json:` with `serialize_data` instead of `render_serialized`, bypassing error/JSON conventions
records.rationale: The diff verifiably changes GET /groups/:id/members from rendering a serialized array (`render_serialized(members.to_a, GroupUserSerializer)`) to `render json: {members: ..., meta: {...}}`, a breaking response-shape change for any existing external consumer, with no versioning/deprecation note. This is a real, specific, decision-relevant backward-compatibility/architecture risk grounded in the diff, not a defect in the new behavior itself (the new frontend consumes the new shape). The render_serialized-vs-render_json point is secondary but accurate.

User.find_by_username(username) ... group.add(user) }` with `params.require(:usernames)` and no limit, no transaction, no rollback.
